_readme: Prompt data for music/generate.py. The three styles are the ones Tyler said fit GRAVITAS in Music test runs 5 and 6 on 2026-10-20: dark cinematic hybrid (run 5 prompt2_take1), epic dark orchestral (run 6 prompt 2), and dark drill (run 6 prompt 4). The pillar is (days since start_date) mod 3, in pillar_order. The style turns over daily so no two days in a row match. Each day then picks a bpm, three instruments, and a texture from that style, and a mood for the day's pillar, seeded by the date. The written prompt keeps the shape of the winning test prompts. Keep everything English, no artist names, no song titles, no vocals.

templates.Confidence: dark cinematic hybrid, 120 BPM, pounding low drums, distorted cello ostinato, deep braams, intense and relentless, huge and gritty, instrumental
templates.Character: epic dark orchestral, 85 BPM, low brass, war drums, staccato strings, ominous and powerful, huge and wide, instrumental
templates.Respect: dark drill beat, 142 BPM, sliding 808 bass, dark piano, rapid hi-hats, cold and serious, tight and punchy, instrumental
